title: Hertz Helps Drive the Vote this Election Day with One Free Rental Day with a Two+ Day Rental
summary: Today, Hertz announced its Free Day on Election Day promotion, offering customers one day free* on a rental of two consecutive days or more when they pick up October 21 through November 3 at participating Hertz neighborhood locations.
body_markdown:
**What** : Today, Hertz announced its **Free Day on Election Day** promotion, offering customers one day free* on a rental of two consecutive days or more when they pick up **now through November 3** at participating Hertz neighborhood locations.


**Why:** With thousands of neighborhood locations nationwide, Hertz is making reliable transportation more affordable for people without a car or those who need one for early voting or Election Day.


**Where** : Thousands of participating Hertz neighborhood locations nationwide. Customers must book on Hertz.com using PC code 211636. Additional terms apply: **[View offer details](https://www.hertz.com/us/en/deals-and-offers/us-offers/enjoy-1-free-day-and-drive-the-vote)**


.


**Also:** Customers can save up to 25% on base rates when they pay now. **[View offer](https://www.hertz.com/us/en/deals-and-offers/us-offers/save-up-to-25-now)** .


**Reserve for at least two days and pay for one less day at participating Hertz neighborhood locations. Applies to the pay later base rental rate only; taxes, fees and options excluded. No voter registration or proof of voting is required. The offer is not affiliated with or intended to support any candidate or political party. Standard terms and exclusions apply:* **[View offer details](https://www.hertz.com/us/en/deals-and-offers/us-offers/enjoy-1-free-day-and-drive-the-vote)**
